title: Architecture policy
description: The single source of truth for module boundaries. Both lint and the architecture tests are built from it.

doors.description: Door file name -> role. A browser door exports only browser-safe types, schemas and components. A server door exports only service operations and server components. Both are listed by name, never `export *`.

edges.description: Declared module dependencies. Anything not listed is refused; a cycle is refused.

tables.description: Every table and the one module that owns it. Only the owner writes it.

readExceptions.description: One reader FILE may import one owner table directly, for reads only. Prefer an owner query function; an import check cannot tell a read from a raw-SQL write.

exemptions.description: Files a rule does not apply to, for example seed scripts. Never for a non-negotiable rule.

clients.description: Third-party ports under src/clients/<name>, each with providers/.

$schemaVersion.description: The blueprint release this file was written for. Scripts refuse a different major version.

roots.description: Files allowed directly under srcRoot. Every other file must live in app, modules/<declared>, shared, ui, db or clients/<declared>.

serverOnlyPackages.description: Packages (and subpaths) a browser bundle must never reach, besides Node builtins.

rulesMayImport.description: External packages a *.rules.ts file may use. Rules otherwise reach only other rules, types, schemas and shared/result.

layout.description: Optional. Where each folder of the blueprint lives, relative to srcRoot. A key left out keeps its default (the 1.0.0 layout).

app.description: Next.js routes, pages, actions. Default: app

modules.description: One folder per module. Default: modules

ui.description: The project's design system. Default: ui

clients.description: Third-party ports, one folder each. Default: clients

dbClient.description: The database client and transaction gateway. Default: db/index.ts

schemaRoot.description: The persistence composition root. Default: db/schema.ts

serverShared.description: Server-only shared files. Default: shared/auth.ts, shared/env.ts, shared/access.ts

resultFile.description: The one shared file a rules file may import. Default: shared/result.ts

compositionFolders.description: Folder names inside app/ that hold page composition. Default: _shell, _components

worker.description: The worker process's entry point. Default: worker.ts

sessionModule.description: Optional. The module that reads the signed-in session (accounts in the template). Reading the session is not a workflow step, so the workflow check does not count it.
